summary: Catheter Precision, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement to acquire 2,941,176 shares of Volato Group, Inc. common stock at $0.34 per share, totaling $1,000,000, in a private placement. The filing describes an investment, not a control-oriented acquisition, with no stated premium, board recommendation, or advisor. The transaction includes a registration rights agreement. This is a routine investment disclosure under Item 1.01, not a special situation as the purchase is minority stake without governance changes or strategic event. What to watch: completion of customary closing conditions; no risk-arb angle.
